name: Geospatial Vector Tiles & Self-Hosted Map Servers
description: Empirical benchmarks evaluating open-source web mapping libraries, vector tile renderers, and PostGIS/PMTiles map servers against commercial map API providers (Mapbox, Google Maps Platform).

repositories.name: Leaflet
repositories.highlight: Lightweight 42KB mobile-first interactive mapping library with universal mobile browser support and thousands of plugins.

repositories.name: MapLibre GL JS
repositories.highlight: Hardware-accelerated WebGL/WebGPU vector tile rendering engine with dynamic client-side styling, 3D terrain, and PMTiles support.

repositories.name: Martin
repositories.highlight: Blazing fast async Rust tile server generating vector tiles directly from PostGIS tables, MBTiles files, and PMTiles archives.

commercial_alternatives_replaced.name: Mapbox Enterprise
commercial_alternatives_replaced.pain_point: Aggressive per-load metering, proprietary closed-source SDK lock-in, and unpredictable traffic spikes.

commercial_alternatives_replaced.name: Google Maps Platform
commercial_alternatives_replaced.typical_pricing: $7.00/1,000 dynamic map loads with tiered billing
commercial_alternatives_replaced.pain_point: Exorbitant cost per map view, third-party user tracking, and rigid API rate limits.
